ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Enrollment in this section is restricted to students in the online MS in the Teaching of Biological Sciences and General Sciences program and graduate non-degree students who are certified teachers. Discussion sessions will be conducted online using Collaborate/Elluminate at the indicated time. Participation in the live discussion session is recommended; discussions will also be recorded and archived online. Visit the following URL: https://courses.las.illinois.edu to access the Moodle Course Management System login page.
